post.description: Starts an MCP session and negotiates the protocol version and capabilities. Returns the session ID in the `mcp-session-id` response header; send it back on all subsequent requests. This is a typed convenience endpoint for the `initialize` JSON-RPC method; standard MCP clients may also post the raw envelope to `/_mcp`. Experimental API, not part of our backwards compatibility promise, thus this API can introduce breaking changes at any time.

mcp-session-id.description: Session ID assigned by the server. Send it as a request header on all following requests.

202.description: Notification accepted. Returned with an empty body for JSON-RPC notifications (requests without an `id`).

post.description: Raw JSON-RPC 2.0 entry point used by standard MCP clients over the Streamable HTTP transport. The `method` is supplied in the request body. For typed, per-method request and response schemas use the `/_mcp/{method}` endpoints (e.g. `/_mcp/tools/call`). Supports batch requests and notifications, which the per-method endpoints do not. Streaming responses are delivered as a `text/event-stream` body on this POST operation. Experimental API, not part of our backwards compatibility promise, thus this API can introduce breaking changes at any time.

parameters.name: mcp-session-id
parameters.description: Session ID returned by the server in the `mcp-session-id` response header after a successful `initialize` request. Required for all subsequent requests within the same session.

parameters.name: sw-context-token
parameters.description: Standard Store API context token identifying the customer session. When provided, MCP tools operate in the context of that customer.

requestBody.description: A JSON-RPC 2.0 request object (or an array of them for batch requests). Omit `id` for notifications (no response expected).

200.description: JSON-RPC response or Server-Sent Events stream. Contains either a `result` (success) or an `error` (failure), never both.

mcp-session-id.description: Session ID assigned by the server. Returned on the `initialize` response and echoed on subsequent responses.

schema.description: Server-Sent Events stream. Each `message` event carries a JSON-RPC response object as defined for `application/json`.

202.description: Notification accepted. Returned with an empty body for JSON-RPC notifications (requests without an `id`).

delete.description: Terminates the active MCP session identified by the `mcp-session-id` header. Experimental API, not part of our backwards compatibility promise, thus this API can introduce breaking changes at any time.

parameters.name: mcp-session-id
parameters.description: Session ID of the session to close. Obtained from the `mcp-session-id` response header of the `initialize` request.

options.description: Handles CORS preflight requests for the Store API MCP endpoint.
